title: Kim Peek's brain anatomy and his recall of 12,000 books

tellings.quote: um a lot of people thought he was autistic he he actually had hydris and so he was born with this um defect in his ability to process the cerebral spinal fluid

plain: A man named Kim Peek, said to have remembered some 12,000 books, was not autistic, as many people thought. He was born with a defect in how his brain handled the fluid around it. The researcher Diane Powell says this on the show, without naming a source, as a case of how an unusual brain might open unusual abilities.
